name: attendance_policy_tracker
description: Counts the visits a patient missed, cancelled late, or moved late, attributes each one to the patient or the clinic, and raises a task at a warning threshold and at a review threshold.

applications.name: Attendance Policy
applications.description: Review and correct the attendance record for any patient.

handlers.description: Serves the review surface, the configuration screen, and the reads and corrections behind them.
Recomputes recently active patients every five minutes and raises the two threshold tasks.
Gates the websocket channel the review surface listens on, open to any staff session.
Signals the channel when a cancellation, a no show, a booking or the clinic label changes.
Stamps the moment this plugin was installed, once, so history before it never enters the count.
